description: The minimap displays the floor's layout accurately but displays Isaac's position inaccurately. Pedestal items and pickups are not what they appear to be. Active items, pills, cards, and rune effects are randomized upon each use, making them very unreliable or deadly (for example [[File:Pickup Suicide King icon.png|link=Suicide King|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Suicide King]][[:Suicide King|Suicide King]]). Items with no charge time (i.e. [[File:Collectible How to Jump icon.png|link=How to Jump|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|How to Jump]][[:How to Jump|How to Jump]], [[File:Collectible IV Bag icon.png|link=IV Bag|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|IV Bag]][[:IV Bag|IV Bag]], etc) can be used repeatedly for random effects. [[File:Stoney.png|link=Fatty#Stoney|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Stonies]][[:Fatty#Stoney|Stonies]] have a chance of being replaced by a [[File:Cross Stoney.png|link=Fatty#Cross Stoney|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Cross Stoney]][[:Fatty#Cross Stoney|Cross Stoney]]. Every boss is [[File:Boss The Bloat ingame.png|link=The Bloat|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|The Bloat]][[:The Bloat|The Bloat]]. Isaac's health is not what it appears to be. Inventory pickups numbers are accurate.

description: All items are randomly generated due to [[File:Collectible TMTRAINER icon.png|link=TMTRAINER|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|TMTRAINER]][[:TMTRAINER|TMTRAINER]]. The theme of each area, its obstacles per area, and music are randomized. Some obstacle sprites are randomized even within a level and sometimes the music may be missing altogether. Occasionally, even the floor texture might glitch out, replacing it with a plain color. Shop item prices range from 1 cent to 99. The challenge itself appears under the challenge list without any text, effectively rendering it invisible.

description: The starting room spawns with no rooms connected to it. Rooms spawn in clusters around the map and must be found via the [[File:Collectible Red Key icon.png|link=Red Key|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Red Key]][[:Red Key|Red Key]]. While the Red Key can be used an infinite number of times, it has 20 uses before [[File:Dark Esau.png|link=Tainted Jacob#Dark Esau|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Dark Esau]][[:Tainted Jacob#Dark Esau|Dark Esau]] spawns. Each subsequent 5 uses will spawn another Dark Esau if [[File:Character Tainted Jacob icon.png|link=Tainted Jacob|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:Tainted Jacob|Tainted Jacob]] has yet to turn into his lost form. The Red Key cannot be used to open doors to [[File:Error Room Icon.png|link=I AM ERROR|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|]][[:I AM ERROR|I AM ERROR]] rooms. Each floor generates as a [[File:Curse of the Labyrinth.png|link=Curses|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Curse of the Labyrinth]][[:Curses|Curse of the Labyrinth]] floor, with one shop, and two item and boss rooms, except the fourth floor, which has only one boss room. All rooms may be from any floor of the current chapter.
